svg.title: Madhanraj M — SDE · Data Engineer · Full Stack
svg.desc: Madhanraj M (@Madan94), software developer and data engineer in Chennai, India. B.E. Computer Science and Engineering at Chennai Institute of Technology, 2024–2028. OpenAI Student Collective Campus Lead and McKinsey Forward participant. Previously interned at RenewCred, Aeroin SpaceTech and Genius Tute. Works with React, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Solidity, Node.js, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, AWS and Docker. Projects: Zypher and Blockpay. Portfolio: madhan.live. Contact: madhanat94@gmail.com.
